trailhead.label: Castelfeder sports-zone car park, Montan (beside the start of the trail)

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
A cattle grid across the path, and gates.
Uneven porphyry rock and old ruin walls beside the path.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Castelfeder sports-zone car park, Montan: Parcheggio della zona sportiva di Castelfeder, Montan (accanto all'inizio del sentiero)
textIt.A cattle grid across the path, and gates: Una griglia per il bestiame sul sentiero, e cancelli.
textIt.Uneven porphyry rock and old ruin walls: Roccia di porfido irregolare e vecchi muri di rovine accanto al sentiero.
